decisions.reason: The GA4 tracking plugin fits the firm's e-commerce analytics focus and became the relevant Google tracking standard in 2024, so it supports client demand and cross-selling into shop optimization services.
A Google Universal Analytics plugin is strategically obsolete in 2024 because the market has shifted to GA4, so maintaining it would tie up resources with little future client value.

A retail system interface plugin matches the firm's technical integration capabilities and offers practical value for merchants connecting shop and back-office processes, making it a sensible complement to its core service business.

Shop relaunch SEO support is closely aligned with the firm's full-service e-commerce positioning and was prominent enough to have its own page, indicating a strategically relevant, service-led offer worth continuing.
